development: Lowest SHA256(seed:query_id) half of SciFact train query IDs; remainder unused. Reject train/test query-ID overlap.
selection: Maximize mean document nDCG@10 on development only, ties by ascending k1,b,rrf_k. Sparse and hybrid selected independently.
scidocs_policy: No train split exists: transfer SciFact-selected parameters unchanged; never tune SCIDOCS test.
input: UTF-8 title, blank line, text; paragraph-v1 with authoritative Go analyzer; no text truncation
embedding: Pinned shipped MiniLM; reject wordpiece overflow, never truncate; no model tuning
document_ranking: Production chunk rankings, including RRF over chunk IDs, collapsed by first occurrence of paper_id; remove query-ID self matches
latency: Single query at a time, warm processes; sparse includes local pipe transport, dense includes query encoding/exhaustive cosine; hybrid includes both and fusion; no HTTP/auth/database overhead
subset_policy: Smoke only: deterministically lowest document/query hashes, never presented as full benchmark quality
